sources.snippet: Chutes AI trained an 8B model on 240 consumer GPUs across 13 countries for $6,500. It now runs on a phone CPU at 59 tokens per second.

sources.title: Chutes | Serverless AI Compute
sources.snippet: Breakthrough Serverless Compute for AI, at Scale. Powering Trillions of Tokens per Month, Chutes is the leading open-source, decentralized compute provider for deploying, scaling and running open-source models in production.

sources.title: Last Week in Chutes | Sept 2nd to Sept 22 | Chutes (@chutes_ai) on X
sources.snippet: Parallax is training in public On 2026-09-10 Jon put the Parallax training register online at parallax.chutes.ai. It is a live dashboard for the current run, a decentralized 8B mixture-of-experts pretraining, and every number on it is read from the fleet as it trains: GPU hosts, tokens per second, tokens trained, peak MFU.
